source: &246 Galatea, my dear! Don't do this!
target: &246 伽拉忒亚，亲爱的！别这样！

source: &73 It's too late to stop me now, 'father'.
target: &73 现在想阻止我，太晚了，“父亲”。

source: &1493 She's sealed the elevators. I'll try a breach...
target: &1493 她封锁了电梯。我试着攻破……

source: &247 Charlie, we must stop them...I fear her plans risk endangering the entire city...
target: &247 查理，我们得阻止他们……她的计划，恐怕会危及整座城市……

source: &1715 Cram it, you son of a bitch!
&1716 You cloned my embryos after Vicky was gone!
target: &1716 维琪死后，你克隆了我的胚胎！

source: &1717 Then you continued the experiments after I was out of the picture!
target: &1717 等我离开，又继续做那些实验！

source: &249 Dr Regis, I can only imagine how you must feel...
target: &249 里吉斯博士，我只能想象你的感受……

source: &1718 What did I JUST say? You don't get to talk!
target: &1718 我刚说了什么？你没资格说话！

source: &1719 Max, what do we know about this...about Galatea's plan?
target: &1719 麦克斯，关于这个……伽拉忒亚的计划，我们知道多少？

source: &1260 Well, she has a dense storage module full of stolen mind-states.
target: &1260 她有一个高密度存储模块，里面全是偷来的意识状态。

source: &1261 And apparently, she's now taken Central's processor core by force.
target: &1261 而且显然，她刚刚强行占领了中枢的处理器核心。

source: &732 Now blocked off from the lower parts of the building, the only way the elevator is going is up - to the core of Central's operations.
target: &732 大楼下部已经被封锁。电梯现在只会往上，通向中枢的运作核心。

source: It must have taken some impressive piloting to get this close to the Fulcrum Tower, much less 'dock' with it.
target: 要把浮空艇开到这么靠近支点大厦的位置，已经需要高超的驾驶技术，更别说“靠泊”了。
